title: Skill front matter
description: Front matter of a SKILL.md (AES-P2.1 / SUE-443). A Skill is an orchestration contract: it declares what it needs, what it produces, what must remain true, and what it may not decide. The generator that satisfies it is replaceable.

name.description: Must equal the containing directory name.

description.description: One line, loaded always. This is the progressive-disclosure surface: an agent decides from this alone whether to load the body.

when_not_to_use.description: Required. A description that does not say when NOT to use the Skill is a defect — it is how near-duplicate Skills get picked by coin-flip.

requires.description: Context that must be present. Absence is a refusal, never a prompt to improvise.

governed_by.description: Paths to the constitution, profile, or gates this Skill defers to. Referenced, never copied.

allowed_tools.description: Capability classes, not vendor products. `web_search`, not a named provider.

references.description: Progressive disclosure: material loaded only when the stated condition holds.

evidence.description: How a run of this Skill is proved. A Skill with no acceptance is not enforceable, and an unenforceable Skill is not a Skill.
